title: India's solar climb to 3rd in the world
description:
Solar electricity by country, 2010 to 2025. India went from almost nothing to third in the world, growing about 39% a year since 2015.

Work out doubling times with the Rule of 72, free: https://mba.rimilab.com/#/mba/macroeconomics

Data: Ember and Energy Institute, via Our World in Data (CC BY 4.0).
